_note: AI-drafted Call to Worship — pending Wilson's curation.

registers.label: Spare
lines: Come, Holy Spirit,
the fire of God, the breath of life.
Come like the wind that filled the house,
and rest like flame on all who wait.
Send forth your Spirit, and we are made new.
Renew the face of the earth.
Come, Holy Spirit.
Breathe on us, and we will worship. Amen.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: They were all together when the sound came — a rushing wind that filled the whole house and would not be shut out.
Come, Holy Spirit, breathe on us.
Then the fire: tongues of flame resting on each of them, and strangers from every nation hearing their own language spoken.
Come, Holy Spirit, breathe on us.
The same breath that hovered over the waters, the same breath the risen Lord blew into the room — that breath is moving here.
Come, Holy Spirit, breathe on us.
Send forth your Spirit, O God; renew the face of the earth, and kindle your fire in us.
Come, Holy Spirit, breathe on us.

registers.label: Hybrid
lines: A rushing wind filled the house where they waited.
Come, Holy Spirit, breathe on us.
Tongues of fire rested on them, and every nation heard.
Come, Holy Spirit, breathe on us.
The risen Lord breathed, and they were filled.
Come, Holy Spirit, breathe on us.
Send forth your Spirit; renew the earth. Come, let us worship.
Come, Holy Spirit, breathe on us.
